summary: Backend Phase 4 (Reviews / Agent Score / Analytics / Lead CRM) fully verified against the preview URL. 33/33 test cases pass in a serial run (see /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_reviews_score_crm.py). All 7 requested feature areas plus the regression sweep are green. One flaky ConnectTimeout was observed on TestRegression.test_public_agent during a subsequent full-suite run — the endpoint returned 200 on immediate retry (transient preview-URL latency, NOT a code issue). No backend defects were found in reviews_score_crm.py.

minor.issue: Intermittent 30s ConnectTimeout observed once during the full-suite run at the ingress layer. Endpoint returned 200 on immediate retry. Not reproducible; likely a transient preview-URL cold-start.

critical_code_review_comments: reviews_score_crm.py:201 — admin users (demo included) bypass the 'meaningful interaction' guardrail. The demo user seeded lead_unlocks anyway during testing so behaviour was covered, but flag this for future non-admin production QA.

reviews_score_crm.py:334 — _recompute_agent_rating is called both when the new status is 'approved' AND when the previous status was 'approved' (to handle un-approve). Good; verified the reject → public list = [] flow works.
reviews_score_crm.py:681 — 'responded_at' is stamped once when status leaves 'new'. Verified in test_patch_second_status_preserves_responded_at that a second status change does NOT overwrite it.

reviews_score_crm.py:635 — 'open' status filter uses $nin ['won','lost'] on crm_status; leads with the default (missing) crm_status are still returned. This matches the spec ('excludes won/lost'). No bug, but note the query does not match leads that literally have no crm_status field yet — MongoDB $nin returns them (verified in test).
seed_data_creation: Inserted transient rows into db.lead_unlocks for (a) satisfying the review guardrail for the fresh reviewer, (b) seeding one owned lead for the demo agent, (c) creating a 'lost' lead to validate the 'open' filter. Also created transient users: reviewer1_<ts>, reporter1_<ts>, reporter2_<ts>, outsider_<ts>, nonagent_<ts>, starter_<ts>. All prefixed with role names; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_reviews_score_crm.py uses module-level pytest attributes to pass IDs between test cases in the same class order — run with -o addopts='' to disable pytest-xdist parallelism (root pytest.ini defaults to -n auto --dist loadscope which will split classes across workers and break the shared review_id). Command that works: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_phase4_reviews_score_crm.py -o addopts='' --junitxml=...`. Requires MONGO_URL + EXPO_BACKEND_URL env.
